skill.name: k8s
skill.description: Kubernetes troubleshooting and manifest judgment: pod crashes, probes, resources and QoS, rollouts, DNS, storage, RBAC. Use when debugging clusters, reviewing manifests, or tuning workloads.
skill.summary: When To Use - A pod is Pending, CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff, or stuck Terminating - A Service or Ingress receives no traffic, or DNS inside the cluster is flaky - Writing or reviewing manifests: probes,
